verdict.rationale: Kong ships decK, a CLI tool for declarative configuration management (APIOps) that lets users dump/sync Gateway and Konnect configuration in YAML/JSON, an open format that supports backup and migration away from the platform. However, the evidence never explicitly frames this as a full-data export/'leave the platform' guarantee, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of a complete data-export workflow is present. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full data export (including logs, analytics, AI Gateway data) in open formats, and independent verification that decK exports 100% of platform state without vendor lock-in.
